exposure: pre-existing cardiovascular comorbidities (thrombophilia, chronic nephropathy, hypertension, optic neuropathy)
cohort: The cohort consists of a single 31-year-old primigravid patient at 30 weeks gestation with pre-existing comorbidities.
finding: Pregnant women with cardiovascular comorbidities are prone to severe complications of SARS-CoV-2 infection, including acute pancreatitis.
